use: Фон заставки Journal; логотип и текст рисует интерфейс отдельными слоями
referenceDescription: Пользователь предоставил lazer.jpg, lazer_loa.jpg и logo.png. Новая сцена по описанию лазерной резки; исходный logo.png переиспользуется без генерации.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: a lightweight desktop application startup splash background for a laser-cutting order journal.
Primary request: Create a polished photographic close-up of an industrial fiber laser cutting a flat steel sheet. Inspired by the supplied conversation photos of a laser cutting head with sparks, but make a new original image.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, designed for a 640 by 360 logical pixel splash. Laser head and focal point sit in the right half, with a controlled spray of fine warm orange sparks toward the far right. The left 45 percent is naturally dark, uncluttered navy charcoal negative space for a company logo and two lines of application text which the application will render separately. The lower edge is calm and dark for a status line. Show a plausible metal cutting head, steel sheet, and slatted laser bed, close-up workshop setting. Sharp equipment details, subtle depth of field, restrained industrial photography.
Lighting: cool navy and slate ambient tones, warm realistic cutting sparks. Bright focus localized on the right, avoid a huge white blown-out flash. Modern, quiet and professional.
Constraints: no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no frame, no fake progress bar, no interface. No people. Image only, edge to edge. Output landscape at 1280x720 if supported.
